# Matthew Ovie Enamuotor

> Frontend and mobile developer based in London, Ontario, Canada. Frontend Developer at Rentsync, building web applications for the real estate industry. Works across React, Next.js and Vue on the web, and React Native, Swift and Kotlin on mobile. Previously five years of freelance work (anomalitech.com: 200+ websites for 130+ clients across four continents) and BOAS (boas.co), where he helped move the store from a Shopify theme to a headless build on Strapi and the Shopify Storefront API. B.Eng in Computer Engineering and a postgraduate diploma in Mobile Application Development. Builds for the keyboard user, the screen reader and the slow phone first.

## Pages

- [Home](https://oviematthew.com): Selected work, about, and contact.
- [Blog](https://oviematthew.com/blog): Technical writing on React, Next.js, Vue, mobile development, security and AI tooling.

## Selected work

- [From Ashes](https://oviematthew.com/project/from-ashes): Story-driven open-world game in the browser. Three.js, Supabase, Azure Speech and Blender MCP. A voiced cast, an economy of copper and shillings, stamina and strength progression, stealth, fights, cars, accounts, cloud saves and a Stripe shop.
- [Footy Teams](https://oviematthew.com/project/footy-teams): Web app that builds balanced pickup football teams from a pasted player list. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [Realtor Block](https://oviematthew.com/project/realtor-block): Real estate listings platform with map search and agent accounts. Next.js, Supabase, Clerk, Google Maps API.
- [BOAS](https://oviematthew.com/project/boas): Denim wholesale storefront, migrated from Shopify Liquid to headless Next.js with Strapi.
- [Addict Wellness App](https://oviematthew.com/project/chattee-app): Recovery support app concept with real-time chat and community. React Native, Firebase.
- [Bedge Pictures](https://oviematthew.com/project/bedge-pictures): Wedding photography site with a markdown blog and spam-protected contact form. Next.js, GSAP.
- [Lizz Davies](https://oviematthew.com/project/lizz-davies): Bridal and occasion hairstylist site rebuilt from WordPress to Next.js.

## Skills

- Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Sass, shadcn/ui, Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Accessibility (WCAG)
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, Swift, Kotlin, Java
- State and APIs: Redux, Zustand, Context API, GraphQL, REST
- Backend and data: Node.js, Express, Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite
- CMS and commerce: Shopify, Liquid, Storefront API, Strapi, Headless CMS, WordPress, WooCommerce, Wix
- AI and tooling: AI-assisted coding, Playwright, Jest, Git, Docker, Vercel, Netlify, CI/CD, Figma
